text:
Alex R: rolled token-trickle budgeter to canary (r2 routes) ~11:45 PT. Seeing p95 up ~140ms vs baseline on text-completion paths — mostly long-context prompts. attaching quick perf summary.

Priya K: perf link https://perf.internal/redwood/trace/365987 — flamegraph points to attention kernel stalls at p95 (spikes during KV re-prefetch).

Miguel S: alex, what are we seeing for KV hit rates on the affected routes?

Alex R: kv_hit=0.46 on canary vs 0.65 baseline. looks like token budget shrink is increasing cache churn and causing extra prefetch roundtrips. microbatch sizes also dropped.

Sasha L: that makes sense — if token budgets trim early we end up with shorter sequences and more distinct prefixes, evicting useful KV entries.

Alex R: avg microbatch went from 16 -> 9. our fused-attn kernel has a sweet spot >=12; below that its startup dominates and p95 jumps.

Jordan T: proposal: kernel-selection rule based on microbatch size. if batch_size < 12, switch to fallback kernel Y with lower startup. should reduce p95 even if throughput slightly worse.

Miguel S: also we should gate token-trickle by route tier: enterprise routes get a higher budget floor so they don't hit this thrash. queue policy can favor those too.

Priya K: quick experiment plan:
1) revert token-trickle to 60% floor for r2 canary
2) add kernel selection threshold: fallback when microbatch < 12
3) increase KV prefix TTL for canary to 5m to reduce churn

ops-bot: deploy-started token-trickle-revert-canary by @Alex R (run id: d2f3) :rocket:

Alex R: running A/B: 10% stay on aggressive token-trickle, 90% on reverted config. watching p95, kv_hit, microbatch_size. will report in ~1h.

Sasha L: also add lightweight per-request probe: record seq_len, microbatch_size, kernel_choice, kv_hit. helps correlate which factor dominates.

Jordan T: config snippet to test locally:
```
batcher:
  min_microbatch: 4
  kernel_switch_threshold: 12
token_trickle:
  enabled: true
  budget_floor_pct: 60
kv_cache:
  ttl_seconds: 300
queue:
  priority_map: { enterprise: 0, standard: 1 }
```

Miguel S: I'll wire alerts: p95 > baseline + 100ms OR kv_hit < 0.55 -> page paging list. also graph kernel_choice vs p95.

Priya K: longer term: replace static token-floor with per-route adaptive budgeter that considers kv_hit and observed batch_size. if kv_hit low or batch_size small, increase budget automatically.

Alex R: agreed. short-term revert then iterate on adaptive heuristics. I'll post the first-hour metrics and flamegraphs when available. thanks all :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-success token-trickle-revert-canary (duration 12m).
